name: Your Farm
description: Home sweet home. Layout depends on the farm map you chose.

name: Bus Stop
description: Connects the farm to town. The bus to the Desert leaves here once repaired.

name: Pelican Town
description: Shops, homes, the Saloon, the clinic and the town square.

name: Cindersap Forest
description: Marnie's Ranch, Leah's cottage, the Wizard's Tower, a river and a pond.

name: The Beach
description: Willy's Fish Shop, Elliott's cabin, the piers and tide pools.

name: The Mountain
description: Robin's Carpenter's Shop, the mountain lake, the Mines and the Adventurer's Guild.

name: Railroad
description: Opens after the earthquake on Summer 3, Year 1. The Spa is here.

name: Backwoods
description: The path from the farm up to the mountain.

name: Quarry
description: East of the mountain, across the bridge (repaired via the Community Center or Joja).

name: Secret Woods
description: Hidden behind a large log in Cindersap Forest (needs a Steel Axe).

name: The Sewers
description: Krobus' shop. Entered through the grate south of town with the Rusty Key.

name: The Mines
description: Entrance on the mountain, east of the lake.

name: Calico Desert
description: Reached by bus once repaired. The Oasis, Casino and Skull Cavern.

name: Witch's Swamp
description: Reached through the Witch's Hut, beyond the Railroad.

name: Ginger Island
description: Reached by Willy's boat once it is repaired.
